title: The Junior clerk in the office
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：junior　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 junior 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the musician wrote of ① a junior clerk in the office in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so junior that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the junior ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the junior clerk in the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too junior to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the junior ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a junior team of the school, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as junior as the team of the school they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was junior or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something junior, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite junior; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the junior ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, with great care, she wrote of another junior clerk in the office in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less junior than anybody had expected. ⑩ The junior team of the school that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the junior ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 初级（前置定语 a junior clerk in the office：1979 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件初级的职员）
B. adj. 初级／资历较浅（两处加强说法：so junior that … 与 no less junior than …）
C. adj. 初级／资历较浅（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 初级（表语 too junior to do：母亲觉得它太初级，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 资历较浅（前置定语 a junior team of the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩资历较浅的队）
F. adj. 资历较浅（同级比较 as junior as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校低年级的队相比）
G. adj. 资历较浅（后置定语 something junior：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 资历较浅（受程度副词修饰 quite junior：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a junior clerk in the office
the junior clerk in the office that
a junior team of the school
The junior team of the school that

answers.why: junior 意为“初级”，1979 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件初级的职员”，此处作前置定语 a junior clerk in the office。
junior 意为“初级”，此处用 so junior that 结构，说它初级到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
junior 意为“初级”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的初级办公室的初级职员，等于最高级的说法。
junior 意为“初级”，母亲认为这件东西“太初级了，谁也用不上”，too junior to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
junior 意为“资历较浅”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩资历较浅的队”，此处作前置定语 a junior team of the school。
junior 意为“资历较浅”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校低年级的队一样资历较浅”，同级比较用 as junior as。
junior 意为“资历较浅”，节目单上那半行字要的是“资历较浅的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something junior。
junior 意为“资历较浅”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当资历较浅”，quite 修饰原级 junior。
junior 意为“资历较浅”，no less junior than 表示“其资历较浅不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之资历较浅不亚于任何人的预料。
junior 意为“资历较浅”，母亲 1991 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的资历较浅队”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件初级的职员。（a junior clerk in the office）
它初级到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so junior that …）
母亲觉得它太初级，谁也用不上。（too junior to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩资历较浅的队。（a junior team of the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校低年级的队一样资历较浅。（as junior as …）
到了 1986 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件资历较浅的东西。（something junior）
answers: In 1979 the musician wrote of a junior clerk in the office in the programme.
It was so junior that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too junior to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a junior team of the school.
He said nobody would call it as junior as the team of the school they had once had.
By 1986 the programme asked for nothing but something junior.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 junior 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the musician wrote of a junior clerk in the office in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the junior clerk in the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too junior to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a junior team of the school, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite junior, and everybody laughed.
The junior ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
